table.name: TLGNC_LDPOINT_MAT_RESTR
table.description: Contains the restrictions (availability) of Materials for a certain Loadingpoint. A Loadingpoint must have all materials explicitly listed which can be loaded there; if no restriction exists this does NOT mean 'all materials, without restriction'! A Shippingpoint does not have material restrictions on his own, but it implicitely has all material of all its loadingpoints. Special case: A Shippingpoint without loadingpoints can load all materials

column.name: LOADINGPOINT_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_loadingpoint. The Loadingpoint to which the restriction applies.

column.name: SAP_MATERIAL_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_material. The Material/Product which is allowed/possible at this Loadingpoint. If no material restriction exists for a loadingpoint this means: nothing is available there, i.e. it cannot be used for loading.
